=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~340-~619 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Parameter expansion in command position is not blocked, so `$cmd`/`${SHELL}` can bypass the literal-name validator and execute a disallowed shell at runtime.
  WHY: All reviewers describe the same runtime bypass: the validator checks literal tokens before expansion, while the shell later expands them to a blocked command.
- agents.md:136-162 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE` is emitted by the script/tests but is missing from the documented stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream tooling that treats agents.md as authoritative will not recognise or may drop that prefix.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~745 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Variable expansion inside unquoted heredoc bodies is not checked or rejected.
  WHY: Unquoted heredocs still perform parameter expansion at execution time, but the validator only rejects command substitution, backticks, and process substitution.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~421-~825 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: Backslash-continuation reconstruction still mis-handles the `bash\n-c` edge case and can fuse tokens into `bash-c`.
  WHY: The reconstruction logic does not always preserve the whitespace semantics the shell applies around line continuations, so command-boundary analysis can still mis-split.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~572-~619 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Parameter expansion syntax in command position (`$cmd`, `${SHELL}`) bypasses the blocked-command validator.
  WHY: The validator inspects the literal token text only, so a generated wrapper containing `cmd=bash; $cmd -c '...'` or `${SHELL} -c '...'` passes validation but expands to a blocked shell at runtime.
- agents.md:142-151 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE` is emitted by `scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh` but is not listed in agents.md's stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream log analysis or monitoring that consumes agents.md as the authoritative log-prefix registry would miss or misclassify `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE` lines.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:571-605 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Parameter expansion tokens in command position bypass the blocked-command check.
  WHY: The validator compares the literal token text against the hardcoded blocklist, but does not detect that these tokens contain shell variable expansion syntax.
- agents.md:148-151 | confidence=5

  WHY: Downstream log analysis consumers that rely on agents.md as the authoritative contract will miss or mishandle this prefix, leading to incomplete log processing or silent data loss in monitoring pipelines.

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:572-604 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Parameter expansion tokens in command position bypass the blocked-command check.
  WHY: `command_basename` only inspects the literal token, so `$cmd` or `${SHELL}` in command position passes validation even though the shell expands it to a blocked command at runtime.
- agents.md:136-162 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE` is missing from the stable log-prefix contract, but it is emitted by scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh and referenced in tests/test_review_synthesise_smoke.py.
  WHY: Downstream log analysis tools that rely on agents.md as the contract source may miss or mishandle `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE` log entries because the prefix is not documented in the stable contract.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~553-~553 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Parameter expansion tokens in command position pass validation as literal words but expand to arbitrary commands at runtime.
  WHY: The tokenizer emits `$VAR` and `${VAR}` as TOKEN_KIND_WORD tokens, and `command_basename("$cmd")` returns `"$cmd"`, which matches none of the blocked basenames.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~745 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Dollar-sign variable expansion (`${...}` or `$VAR`) inside unquoted heredoc bodies is not checked.
  WHY: Unquoted heredocs perform parameter expansion at execution time, and the current check only rejects `$(...)`, backticks, and `<(`.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:~421-~825 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Logical-line reconstruction for backslash-continuation can still mis-split in edge cases.
  WHY: The current code concatenates without a separator in the bare `bash\n-c` case, producing `bash-c` instead of preserving the shell's command boundary semantics.
- agents.md:~149 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE` is emitted by behavioural smoke validation wrapper scripts and is asserted-on by tests, but is not listed in the stable log-prefix contract.
  WHY: Downstream log-analysis consumers that rely on agents.md as the authoritative stable-prefix list will not recognise `BEHAVIOURAL_SMOKE_PRESENT_INCONCLUSIVE`, so inconclusive wrapper results can be silently dropped.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:line 340 and line 573 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Parameter expansion tokens in command position bypass the blocked-command validator entirely.
  WHY: The validator compares literal token text against the blocklist before shell expansion occurs, so `$cmd` or `${SHELL}` passes validation but executes a blocked shell command at runtime.
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5 ===
